title: Hips Don't Lie
hook: Intro horn riff, four bars and the held tail: C#-C-A#-F# | F#-G#-A#-F# | C-A#-G#-F | F-F#-G#-F | A#-G#-F#-C | A#-G#-A# (held). Instrumental, no lyric.

evidence.summary: hips-fm track 7 explicit raw indices (riff = the 23 notes of velocity 0.787 in the window) compared event by event with the Hooktheory intro transcription (id yvgPBBdEoYq, B-flat minor, 100 BPM): all 23 pitches equal (shift 0), onsets equal in beats; releases differ because the MIDI plays the riff staccato (about 0.1 beat) while Hooktheory writes full values. musicalnexus mn-hips agrees on 23/23 at +11 on explicit indices.

evidence.summary: vg1 time_bgm.mid track 1 events 0-16 (120 BPM, quarter beats) vs vg3 Temple_of_Time.mid track 0 events 0-16 (100 BPM, -24): 17 pitches and metrical attacks identical. Third sources (pitches asserted, onsets within the stated tolerance): vg2 upper-octave notes (max 0 beat), bitmidi flute (0.060547), bitmidi piano (0.019531), bitmidi piano top voice (0.017578). zeldaret/oot 14759ab sOcarinaSongNotes[OCARINA_SONG_TIME] decodes A4 D4 F4 A4 D4 F4 (+12 = MIDI A5 D5 F5 ...) at 32/66/33/32/65/99 frames; attacks within one frame at 32.5 frames per beat. The statement boundary: the in-game song is the first six notes; events 6-16 rest on the MIDIs.
